140	    def __init__(self, root: Path, run_dir: Path, hidden: tuple[str, ...] = HIDDEN,
141	                 protected: tuple[str, ...] = PROTECTED, sandbox: Any = None):  # fmt: skip
142	        self.root = root.resolve()
143	        self.run_dir = run_dir
144	        self.hidden = hidden

155	    def _resolve(self, path: str) -> tuple[Path, str]:
156	        p = (self.root / (path or ".")).resolve()
157	        if p != self.root and self.root not in p.parents:
158	            raise ValueError(f"outside the checkout: {path}")
159	        rel = p.relative_to(self.root).as_posix() or "."
160	        parts = rel.split("/")
161	        # A .git component at any depth is git's, not the checkout's: a write there could forge a
162	        # nested repository and hide a subtree from the record. The other hidden names are only
163	        # the record at the root.
164	        if parts[0] in self.hidden or ".git" in parts or ".git" in path.split("/"):

168	    def _writable(self, rel: str) -> None:
169	        """The goal's tests and the toolchain are the human's; the builder may read them only."""
170	        name = rel.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
171	        for pattern in self.protected:
172	            if pattern.endswith("/"):  # anything under that directory

210	                lines.append(f"{kind}\t{size}\t{name}")
211	            if len(entries) > LIST_CAP:
212	                lines.append(f"...\t{len(entries) - LIST_CAP} more entries not shown")

218	    def read(self, path: str, start: int = 1) -> str:
219	        """Read a file of the checkout as numbered lines, from line `start` (1-based), at most 300
220	        lines or 32000 bytes per call; a truncated read says where to continue.
221	
222	        Args:
223	            path: The file to read, relative to the checkout root.

228	            if not p.is_file():
